Stock market news | Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs on FII buying

The Sensex and Nifty scaled 9‑month highs after four weeks of continuous gains, as reported on 21 November 2026. This marks a strong upward move in India’s major indices.
Record foreign institutional investor buying underpinned the rally, signalling robust overseas interest and supporting market momentum.
